blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Egocentric video understanding spans diverse capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats, yet these are often studied in isolation despite their tight coupling in real-world interaction. We propose the Ego-Action-World interaction loop as a unifying principle: the wearer perceives the world, forms goals, acts, changes the world, and uses feedback to guide subsequent behavior. Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark organized around four complementary interaction structures: Node captures ego, action, and world states; Edge captures directed relations among them; Chain captures linked dependencies; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions. We develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline that extracts structured interactions from egocentric videos, grounds them in visual and auditory evidence, and generates questions according to their interaction structure. Required modalities and single- or multi-turn formats follow naturally from the supporting evidence and dependencies. EgoOmniWorld contains 24,166 QA groups, including 20,284 training and 3,882 test samples. Experiments on representative open- and closed-source multimodal large language models reveal substantial and uneven limitations across interaction structures. Models trained on EgoOmniWorld improve in-domain interaction understanding and generalize to existing egocentric benchmarks. EgoOmniWorld provides a unified foundation for evaluating and advancing egocentric video understanding. Data, code, and models will be released.
blocks.zh: 以电子为中心的视频理解跨越不同的能力、模式和评价格式,然而,尽管它们在现实世界互动中紧密结合,这些内容往往被孤立地研究。 我们提出"Ego-Action-World"互动循环作为统一原则:穿戴者感知世界,形成目标,行为,改变世界,并使用回馈来指导后续行为. 基于这一观点,我们引入了 " EgoOmniWorld " 这一基准,该基准围绕四个互补互动结构: 节点捕捉自负,动作,和世界状态;边缘捕捉它们之间的定向关系;链捕捉相联的依赖关系;环捕捉反馈-闭塞的相互作用. 我们开发了一个以证据为基础的互动第一数据管道,从以自我为中心的视频中提取结构化互动,将它们放在视觉和听觉证据中,并根据其互动结构产生问题。 所需模式和单一或多回合格式自然地取自佐证和依赖。 EgoOmniWorld包含24,166个QA组,包括20,284个培训和3,882个测试样本. 关于具有代表性的开源和闭源多式大型语言模型的实验表明,在互动结构之间存在着巨大和不均衡的局限性。 在EgoOmniWorld接受过培训的模型增进了对内部互动的理解并概括到现有的以自我为中心的基准。 EgoOmniWorld为评价和推进以自我为中心的视频理解提供了一个统一的基础. 将发布数据、代码和模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Egocentric video understanding has rapidly evolved into a broad and increasingly diverse research landscape Zhang et al. [2023] , Mahdi et al. [2025] , Fu et al. [2025] , Pan et al. [2026a] . Existing benchmarks target a wide range of capabilities, including visual perception Mangalam et al. [2023] , Li et al. [2026] , action understanding Jia et al. [2022] , Rodin et al. [2025] , spatial and temporal reasoning Plizzari et al. [2025b] , Zhang et al. [2026] , Xu et al. [2025b] , intent inference Li et al. [2025] , Pan et al. [2026b] , and planning prediction Cheng et al. [2024a] , Chen et al. [2026] . Recent efforts further span different modality requirements, from vision-only to joint audio-visual understanding Zhu et al. [2026] , Seth et al. [2026] , and evaluation formats, from single-turn question answering to multi-turn dialogue Ye et al. [2025] , Gao et al. [2026] . While each direction captures an important aspect of egocentric understanding, the resulting benchmark landscape remains fragmented, with different capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats often studied under separate task definitions and protocols. The field therefore lacks a common framework for systematically organizing these diverse aspects and understanding how they relate to one another.

blocks.en: A defining characteristic of egocentric video is that it records the world from the perspective of an active participant rather than a passive observer. The wearer continuously perceives the surrounding world, forms goals, and takes actions to achieve them, while the resulting changes in the world provide feedback that guides subsequent decisions and behavior. We refer to this closed process as the Ego–Action–World interaction loop , which naturally connects perception, action understanding, intent reasoning, world-state change, and feedback within a unified framework.
blocks.zh: 以自我为中心的视频的一个决定性特征是,它从积极参与者而不是被动观察者的角度记录世界. 穿戴者不断感知周围的世界,形成目标,并采取行动来实现这些目标,而随之而来的世界变化则提供反馈来指导后续的决定和行为. 我们把这个封闭的进程称为Ego - Action - World interactive round(Ego - Action - World Interactive round),它自然地将感知,行动理解,意图推理,世界-状态变化,以及统一框架内的反馈联系起来.

blocks.en:
Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld , a unified benchmark for egocentric video understanding centered on Ego–Action–World interactions. Rather than organizing questions around isolated capability labels, EgoOmniWorld characterizes complementary structural scopes of the interaction process. Node captures individual Ego, Action, and World states; Edge captures directed relations among the nodes; Chain captures linked dependencies across multiple relations; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions in which action outcomes are perceived by the ego and influence subsequent goals or behavior. Note that these structures represent different scopes of interaction composition rather than a hierarchy of task difficulty.
Likewise, we argue that modality and dialogue form should also not be treated as independent task dimensions. Instead, they arise naturally from the Ego–Action–World interaction process itself: different stages of the interaction call for different evidence, whether visual or audio-visual, and different dependency structures are naturally expressed through single- or multi-turn QA.
In this way, EgoOmniWorld unifies not only diverse understanding capabilities, but also the modalities and dialogue formats through which they are most naturally evaluated.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观点,我们引入了以Ego-Action-World 互动为中心的以自我为中心的视频理解的统一基准EgoOmniWorld。 EgoOmniWorld不是围绕孤立的能力标签来组织问题,而是将互动过程的互补结构范围描绘出来。 节点捕捉单个的"Ego","Action"和"World State";"边缘"捕捉节点之间的定向关系;"链"捕捉多个关系之间的关联依赖关系;"循环"捕捉反馈封闭的相互作用,其中行动结果被自负感所感知并影响后续的目标或行为. 注意这些结构代表了相互作用构成的不同范围,而不是任务难度的分级.
同样,我们主张,方式和对话形式也不应被视为独立的任务。 相反,它们自然地产生于Ego - Action - World 交互进程本身:交互的不同阶段需要不同的证据,无论是视觉证据还是视听证据,不同的依赖性结构自然通过单转或多转QA来表达.
这样,EgoOmniWorld不仅统一了不同的理解能力,而且还统一了最自然地评价它们的方式和对话形式.

blocks.en:
To instantiate this framework, we develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data engine over Ego4D Grauman et al. [2022] and HD-EPIC Perrett et al. [2025] . As illustrated in Figure 1 , rather than generating isolated questions first and composing them afterward, the data engine first reconstructs structured Ego–Action–World interactions from egocentric videos. It identifies ego states and goals, executed actions, world states and changes, and observable feedback; grounds these components in visual and auditory evidence; and aggregates related interactions through persistent entities and task episodes. Questions are generated only after the target interaction structure and its supporting evidence have been established, with modality requirements and dialogue forms determined by the evidence and dependencies involved.
This interaction-first design enables Node and Edge questions to be derived from local interaction components, Chain questions from linked dependencies, and Loop questions from feedback-closed cycles, while preserving traceable evidence for each answer. Generated candidates further undergo shared quality checks, structure-specific validation, constrained repair, and revalidation. In total, the resulting EgoOmniWorld benchmark contains 24,166 evidence-grounded QA groups, including 20,284 for training and 3,882 for testing.
blocks.zh:
为了即时化这个框架,我们在Ego4D Grauman et al. [2022] 和 HD-EPIC Perrett et al. [2025] 上开发了互动第一,以证据为基础的数据引擎. 如图1所显示的,数据引擎不是首先产生孤立的问题,然后把它们编织成一个单独的问题,而是首先从自负的视频中重建结构化的Ego-Action-World互动。 它确定自我状态和目标、已执行的行动、世界状况和变化以及可观察到的反馈;将这些组成部分作为视觉和听觉证据的依据;通过持续的实体和任务事件汇总相关互动。 只有在目标互动结构及其辅助证据建立之后,才产生问题,方式要求和对话形式由所涉证据和依附因素决定。
这种交互先行设计使得节点和边缘问题能够从本地交互组件中衍生出,链子问题从相联的依赖性中衍生出,而循环问题则从反馈-闭合周期中衍生出,同时为每个答案保留可追踪的证据. 生成的候选人进一步接受共享质量检查、特定结构的验证、有限的修理和重新验证。 由此产生的EgoOmniWorld基准共有24 166个循证质量保证组,包括20 284个培训组和3 882个测试组。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments on various open- and closed-source multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reveal three key findings. First, current models exhibit markedly different strengths across Ego–Action–World interaction structures and semantic categories, suggesting that aggregate performance alone obscures important capability gaps. Second, training on EgoOmniWorld consistently improves in-domain interaction understanding under both LoRA and full fine-tuning; for example, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B improves from 36.42% to 47.36% with LoRA and 48.34% with full fine-tuning.
Third, the trained model demonstrates zero-shot transfer to EgoSound, EgoTempo, and EgoToM, achieving gains of up to 8.08 percentage points.
blocks.zh:
对各种开源和闭源多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)的广泛实验揭示出三种关键发现. 首先,目前的模型在Ego-Action-World互动结构和语义分类上表现出明显不同的长处,这表明仅综合性能就掩盖了重要的能力差距。 第二,关于 " EgoOmniWorld " 的培训在LORA和全面微调下不断改善域内互动理解;例如,Qun2.5-Omni-7B与LORA相比从36.42%提高到47.36%,与全面微调相比从48.34%。
第三,训练有素的模型显示向"EgoSound","EgoTempo"和"EgoTOM"的零发转会,实现最高8.08个百分点的增收.

blocks.en:
In summary, our contributions are threefold:
1) we introduce an Ego–Action–World interaction framework with four complementary structures—Node, Edge, Chain, and Loop—for systematically capturing diverse aspects of egocentric understanding;
2) we instantiate this framework as EgoOmniWorld , a 24,166-sample evidence-grounded benchmark constructed with an interaction-first data engine, spanning diverse capability scopes, modality requirements, and evaluation formats; and
3) we demonstrate that EgoOmniWorld serves as both a unified diagnostic testbed and a source of transferable supervision for egocentric video understanding.
2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Beyond capability-specific evaluation, recent benchmarks have expanded along modality and dialogue dimensions.
EgoLifeQA Yang et al. [2025] , EgoSound Zhu et al. [2026] , and EgoAVU Seth et al. [2026] extend egocentric understanding from vision-only input to audio-visual reasoning. Meanwhile, recent efforts e.g., LifeEval Gao et al. [2026] move beyond single-turn QA toward multi-turn or dialogue-based evaluation.
Table 1 provides a representative, rather than exhaustive, comparison of existing benchmarks in terms of interaction structure, input modality, and dialogue format. Viewed through the Ego–Action–World lens, these works substantially broaden the landscape of egocentric understanding, but remain organized around different task definitions, modality settings, and evaluation protocols, without a common structure connecting them. EgoOmniWorld instead treats these dimensions as natural properties of the underlying interaction: the required modality follows from the available supporting evidence, while single- or multi-turn QA follows from the dependency structure being evaluated.

blocks.en: This section presents the core design of EgoOmniWorld (Section 3.1 ), its interaction-first data engine for structuring Ego–Action–World interactions into evidence-grounded VQA (Section 3.2 ), and the resulting benchmark statistics (Section 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Core Design Principles
blocks.zh: 3.1 核心设计原则

blocks.en: Figure 2: The EgoOmniWorld taxonomy. Left: an egocentric interaction loop. Middle: the Ego–Action–World structure, comprising three node states and six directed edge relations. Right: four complementary interaction structures, from Node to Loop, with example questions.
blocks.zh: 图2:伊果奥姆尼世界分类学. 左:以自我为中心的互动循环. 中间:Ego–Action–World结构,由三个节点状态和六个直接边缘关系组成. 右:四个互补的交互结构,从节点到Loop,并附有示例问题.

blocks.en:
EgoOmniWorld is built around the defining closed-loop nature of egocentric interaction: the wearer perceives the world, acts according to a goal, changes the world, and observes the resulting state to guide subsequent behavior.
We organize this process around three design principles.
blocks.zh:
EgoOmniWorld是围绕自我中心互动的定义性闭锁-loop性质来构建的:穿戴者感知世界,按照目标行事,改变世界,并观察由此产生的状态来引导后行行为.
我们围绕三项设计原则组织这一进程。

blocks.en:
Four structures capture complementary interaction scopes. Rather than defining tasks by isolated capability labels, EgoOmniWorld derives four structural scopes from the Ego–Action–World process, as in Figure 2 . Node targets individual Ego, Action, or World states, corresponding to Ego State , Action Status , and World State . Edge targets one directed relation between two components: Ego → \to Action ( Goal Planning ), Action → \to Ego ( Intent Attribution ), Action → \to World ( Action Effects ), World → \to Action ( Action Grounding ), World → \to Ego ( Intent Formation ), and Ego → \to World ( World Perception ). Chain composes multiple directed relations into linked dependencies, where earlier states, actions, or observations are required to understand later events. Loop closes the interaction cycle by capturing how action outcomes are perceived by the ego and subsequently confirm, adjust, or change its goals or behavior.
Thus, Node, Edge, Chain, and Loop correspond respectively to interaction elements, directed relations, their composition, and feedback closure, rather than a hierarchy of task difficulty.
blocks.zh:
四个结构捕捉互补的相互作用范围. EgoOmniWorld不是用孤立的能力标签来定义任务,而是从Ego-Action-World进程得出了四个结构范围,如图2。 节点针对个人Ego, Action, 或世界国家, 边缘针对两个组成部分之间的一种直接关系:Ego = \ to Action(目标规划)、Action = 为Ego(有意归属)、Action = 世界(行动效果)、World = 行动(行动定位)、World = Ego(有意形成)和Ego = 世界(世界认知)。 链会将多条直接关系构成关联的依存关系,其中需要更早的状态,动作,或观察来理解后期的事件. 循环通过捕捉行为结果如何被自负感所感知并随后确认,调整,或改变其目标或行为来结束互动循环.
因此,Node,Edge,Chain,和Loop分别对应交互元素,定向关系,其组成,以及反馈关闭,而不是任务难度的分级.

blocks.en:
Modality and dialogue form arise from the interaction. Visual and auditory signals are treated as complementary evidence for Ego–Action–World interactions rather than as separate task families.
The modality requirement of each question is determined by the evidence necessary to answer it, yielding visual, auditory, or audio-visual questions.
Likewise, dialogue form follows the dependency structure being evaluated: local states or relations can be probed in a single turn, while multi-turn QA can expose intermediate states and dependencies across an interaction.
Modality and dialogue form are therefore orthogonal to the Node–Edge–Chain–Loop structure and are instantiated according to the underlying evidence and interaction dependencies.
blocks.zh:
互动产生模式和对话形式。 视觉信号和听觉信号被视为Ego-Action-World互动的补充证据,而不是单独的任务家族.
每个问题的方式要求由回答问题所需的证据决定,产生视觉、听觉或视听问题。
同样,对话形式也遵循正在评价的依赖性结构:可以一次性地探究当地状态或关系,而多回合的QA可以通过互动暴露中间状态和依赖性.
因此,模式和对话形式与节点-Edge-Chain-Loop结构是正向的,并且根据基本证据和相互作用的依赖性进行即时分析。

blocks.en:
Step 1: Local Interaction Extraction. We first segment each video window into individual actions. For each
action, we record the world state before it, the goal and current subgoal it
serves, its outcome, and the feedback received by the wearer. A goal is
recorded only when it is supported by speech, context, or later consequences.
Failed and interrupted actions are retained, as they often reveal how feedback
changes behavior. The output is a set of timestamped interaction records.
blocks.zh:
步骤1:地方互动提取。 我们首先将每个视频窗口分解为单个行动。 每人
行动,我们记录它面前的世界状况,目标和目前的次级目标
服务、结果和穿戴者收到的反馈。 一个目标是

保留失败和被中断的行动,因为它们往往揭示如何反馈
改变行为 输出是一组有时间戳的交互记录.

blocks.en:
Step 2: Multimodal Evidence Grounding. We then attach supporting evidence to each interaction record. Auditory
evidence includes speech and action-related sounds, and visual evidence
includes object properties, hand–object contacts, and scene layout. Each
observation is timestamped and labeled with its modality. Entity identifiers
link repeated observations of the same object across windows, while its states
at different times are kept separate. For example, turning a page of a manual
is grounded in both the newly visible page and the paper-rustling sound. These
modality labels later determine the modality requirement of each question.
blocks.zh:
步骤2:多式联运证据基础。 然后我们在每个互动记录中附上佐证证据。 审计
证据包括言论和与行动有关的声音,以及视觉证据
包括对象属性、手-对象联系人和场景布局。 每个
观察是用其方式贴上时间戳和标签的。 实体标识符
链接同一对象在窗口之间的重复观测,而其状态
在不同的时间是分开的。 例如,翻出手册的一页
既基于新可见的页面,也基于倒纸的声音。 这些
模式标签随后确定每个问题的模式要求。

blocks.en:
Step 3: Episode Aggregation and Dependency Linking. Chain and Loop questions require connections across multiple
interactions. We therefore group adjacent interactions that serve the same
activity stage into task episodes. Two episodes are linked only when a state,
instruction, failure, or unfinished task carries over from one to the other.
Temporal adjacency or a shared object alone is not sufficient. Each link
records the connected components, the transferred state, and the required
modalities. The output is a set of episodes and dependency links, from which
Chain and Loop questions are generated.

blocks.en:
Step 4: Evidence-Grounded QA Generation and Validation. QA generation follows an evidence-first principle: the supporting
evidence and the target structure are selected before the question and answer
are written. Node and Edge questions are generated from local interaction
records, and Chain and Loop questions from linked episodes. In multi-turn QA,
the final turn must combine earlier turns with new evidence, so it cannot be
answered from the dialogue history alone. All candidates are then checked for
evidential support, temporal consistency, modality correctness, answer
leakage, and structural validity. Failed candidates are repaired using existing
records only and then re-validated. A random subset of the final QA is further
reviewed by humans (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: EgoOmniWorld serves as a unified testbed and training resource for egocentric interaction understanding. We further investigate cross-benchmark transfer and analyze fine-grained capability gains and interaction coverage.
blocks.zh: EgoOmniWorld是自我中心互动理解的统一测试和培训资源。 我们进一步调查跨基准转让,并分析精细的能力收益和互动覆盖面。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Baseline models. We evaluate 11 open- and closed-source omni-modal MLLMs on EgoOmniWorld. The three closed-source systems include Gemini 3.8 Flash Team et al. [2023] , Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus Team [2026] , and Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash Team [2026] . The eight open-source models include MiniCPM-o 2.6 (8B) Cui et al. [2026] , SALMONN2+ (7B and 72B) Sun et al. [2025] , VideoLLaMA2-AV-7B Cheng et al. [2024b] , Qwen2.5-Omni (3B and 7B) Xu et al. [2025a] , and Qwen3-Omni (Thinking and Instruct variants) Team [2026] .
blocks.zh: 基线模型。 我们评价了EgoOmniWorld上的11个开源和闭源的自闭式MLLM。 三个闭源系统包括双子座 3.8 Flash Team等 [2023], Quen3.5-Omni-Plus Team [2026],和 Quen3.8-Omni-Flash Team [2026]. 8个开源模型包括MiniCPM-o 2.6 (8B) Cui等 [2026],SALMONN2+(7B和72B) Sun等 [2025], VideoLLaMA2-AV-7B Cheng等 [2024b]; Quen2.5-Omni (3B和7B) 徐等 [2025a]; Quen3-Omni (思和教化变体) Team [2026].

blocks.en: EgoOmniWorld training. To test whether the benchmark also works as supervision, we train two open-source models, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and Qwen3-Omni-Thinking, on the EgoOmniWorld training split. Each model is trained in two ways: LoRA, which adds low-rank adapters and leaves the base weights unchanged, and full fine-tuning (FFT), which updates the model weights directly. Training supervises the reference answers; in multi-turn dialogues, earlier turns are included and their answers are supervised as well. Videos are sampled at two frames per second with at most 64 frames and 200,704 pixels per frame, and the audio track is kept. Both regimes share the same schedule and precision settings; learning rates, adapter targets, and distributed settings are listed in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 爱高奥姆尼世界训练. 为了测试该基准是否也起到监督作用,我们在EgoOmniWorld的训练分出上,训练了两个开源模型:Qun2.5-Omni-7B和Qun3-Omni-Thinking. 每个模型都经过了两种训练:LORA,它添加了低等适配器并保持了基重不变;而全微调(FFT),它直接更新了模型的重. 培训监督参考答复;在多回合对话中,包括较早的轮次,并监督其答复。 视频以每秒两帧为样本,每帧最多可有64帧和200,704像素,并保留了音频音轨. 两种制度都有相同的时间表和精确设置;学习率、适配对象和分布式设置列于附录E.1。

blocks.en: In-domain inference protocol. All models are evaluated on the EgoOmniWorld test set. For multi-turn QA, models condition on their own previous responses rather than reference answers, thereby evaluating their ability to maintain consistency across dialogue turns. Predictive questions are restricted to observations available before the decision cutoff. All models are evaluated using the same reference answers and scoring rubric.
blocks.zh: 域内推论协议. 所有模型都通过EgoOmniWorld测试集进行评估. 对于多回合的QA,模型以自己以前的答复而不是参考答案为条件,从而评价它们是否有能力保持对话回合的一致性. 预测性问题仅限于决定截止日期之前的观察。 所有模型都使用相同的参考答案和评分分分号进行评估.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics and judge. We report answer accuracy (%) and mean score (0–5), both overall and by interaction category. A locally hosted Qwen3.8-27B serves as a text-only judge, receiving the question, reference answer, model response, and dialogue context when applicable, without access to the source video. The judge first determines binary correctness and then assigns an ordinal score from 0 to 5, with scores of 4–5 indicating correct answers and 0–3 indicating incorrect ones. Contradictory references and unresolved judgments are flagged for review. Judge prompts, parsing rules, and failure handling are detailed in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 评价尺度和法官。 我们报告答案的准确性(%)和中间分数(0-5),包括总体和互动类别。 当地托管的Qwen3.8-27B担任只提供文本的法官,在适用的情况下接收提问,参考答案,模型回复,以及对话上下文,无法取用源视频. 法官首先确定二进制正确性,然后分配一个从0到5的正数分数,4–5分表示正确答案,0–3分表示错误答案. 矛盾的参考文献和未解决的判决被标出供审查。 法官的提示,解析规则和失败处理详见附录一。

blocks.en: Tansfer benchmarks. To evaluate cross-benchmark generalization, we compare Qwen2.5-Omni-7B before and after EgoOmniWorld LoRA adaptation on three existing egocentric benchmarks: EgoSound Zhu et al. [2026] , EgoTom Li et al. [2025] , and EgoTempo Plizzari et al. [2025a] . No additional training is performed on these target benchmarks, and accuracy is reported using their respective evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 坦斯费尔基准. 为了评价跨基准通用,我们比较了EgoOmni World LoRA前后的Quen2.5-Omni-7B,以三个现有的以自我为中心的基准:EgoSound 朱等 [2026]; EgoTom Li等 [2025]; EgoTempo Plizzari等 [2025a]. 没有对这些目标基准进行额外培训,并使用各自的评价规程报告准确性。

blocks.en:
Testbed analysis. EgoOmniWorld presents substantial challenges for current omni-modal MLLMs. The best closed-sourced model i.e, Gemini 3.8 achieves 61.51% overall accuracy, while the highest-performing open-source baseline reaches 48.15%. Among the evaluated 7B-scale models, the best result is only 36.42%, achieved by Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, highlighting the difficulty of the benchmark.
Beyond overall accuracy, EgoOmniWorld reveals substantial performance variations across interaction structures and semantic categories. In particular, models exhibit different capabilities in recognizing actions, perceiving world states, interpreting intentions, and reasoning about action effects. These variations highlight the diagnostic value of EgoOmniWorld in revealing capability gaps across different components and relationships of the Ego–Action–World interaction process.
blocks.zh:
试卷分析. EgoOmni World对目前的全方位模式的MLLM提出了重大挑战。 最佳的闭源模型即双子座3.8实现61.51%的整体精度,而表现最高的开源基线则达到48.15%. 在被评价的7B级模型中,最佳结果只有36.42%,由Quen2.5-Omni-7B实现,凸显出基准的难度.
除了总体准确性外,EgoOmniWorld还揭示了相互作用结构和语义类别之间的显著性能差异. 特别是,模型在认识行动、了解世界国家、解释意图以及对行动效果的推理方面显示出不同的能力。 这些变化突出了EgoOmniWorld在揭示Ego-Action-World互动进程不同组成部分和关系的能力差距方面的诊断价值。

blocks.en: Training effectiveness. Training on EgoOmniWorld yields substantial overall improvements and broad gains across interaction structures. For Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, LoRA and full fine-tuning (FFT) improve overall accuracy from 36.42% to 47.36% and 48.34%, respectively, with improvements across all four structures and particularly pronounced gains on Edge questions (+13.83 and +15.35 percentage points). Similarly, Qwen3-Omni-Thinking improves from 48.15% to 52.10% with LoRA and 53.18% with FFT, with the latter improving all four structures. The gains vary across models and adaptation strategies: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B benefits more substantially overall, whereas Qwen3-Omni-Thinking shows smaller overall gains, with its LoRA variant slightly reducing Chain and Loop accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of EgoOmniWorld as interaction-centric supervision while highlighting differences in how model families and training strategies benefit from different interaction structures.
blocks.zh: 培训效果。 关于EgoOmniWorld的培训使互动结构的总体情况大有改善并取得了广泛成果。 就Qun2.5-Omni-7B而言,LORA和全微调(FFT)的总精度分别从36.42%提高到47.36%和48.34%,这四个结构都有所改进,边缘问题尤其显著(+13.83和+15.35个百分点)。 同样,Qune3-Omni-Thinking与LORA相比从48.15%提高到52.10%,与FFT相比从53.18%,后者改善了所有四个结构。 收益因模型和适应战略而异: Qun2.5-Omni-7B总体效益更大,而Qun3-Omni-Think则显示总体收益较小,其LORA变体略微降低了链和环的精确度. 这些结果显示了EgoOmniWorld作为以互动为中心的监督的实效,同时突出了模式家庭和培训战略如何从不同的互动结构中受益的差异.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Benchmark Transfer

blocks.en: Zero-shot transfer. We evaluate the transferability of EgoOmniWorld supervision by comparing Qwen2.5-Omni-7B before and after LoRA adaptation on three external egocentric benchmarks: EgoSound, EgoToM, and EgoTempo, without additional training on their respective training sets. As shown in Table 3 , adaptation improves accuracy from 31.33% to 39.41% on EgoSound, from 55.95% to 58.22% on EgoToM, and from 20.40% to 24.80% on EgoTempo, corresponding to gains of 8.08, 2.27, and 4.40 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that the benefits of EgoOmniWorld supervision extend beyond its own benchmark, particularly to audio-visual multimodal egocentric understanding.

Substantial gains are also observed in Action Effects, World Perception, and Intent Formation, suggesting benefits across ego-state understanding, perceptual grounding, and action-related reasoning.

blocks.en: Fragmented interaction coverage. Beyond transfer performance, our taxonomy mapping further reveals the fragmented coverage of existing egocentric benchmarks. Specifically, EgoSound, EgoToM, and EgoTempo each cover only a subset of the Ego–Action–World interaction process, with no explicit evaluation of Chain or Loop in the mapped questions. This highlights the limited coverage of cross-interaction dependencies and feedback-driven adaptation in the benchmarks examined. In contrast, EgoOmniWorld systematically covers all four complementary interaction structures, providing a unified framework for evaluating individual states, directed relations, linked dependencies, and complete Ego–Action–World feedback loops.
blocks.zh: 零散互动报道. 除了转让业绩外,我们的分类图进一步揭示了现有自我中心基准的分散覆盖。 具体来说,EgoSound、EgoTOM和EgoTempo各自仅涵盖Ego–Action–World交互进程的一个子集,在所绘制的问题中没有明确评价链或环. 这突出表明,在所审查的基准中,交叉互动的依赖性和反馈驱动的适应的覆盖面有限。 相比之下,EgoOmniWorld系统覆盖了所有四个互补的相互作用结构,为评价单个国家提供了一个统一的框架,指导关系,关联的依赖性,以及完整的Ego–Action–World反馈循环.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We introduced EgoOmniWorld, a unified benchmark that organizes diverse egocentric video understanding capabilities around the closed Ego–Action–World interaction loop. By structuring this process into four complementary scopes—Node, Edge, Chain, and Loop—we provide a common framework for evaluating individual states, directed relations, linked dependencies, and feedback-closed interactions. Our interaction-first, evidence-grounded data engine further integrates visual and auditory evidence and single- and multi-turn QA according to the underlying interaction requirements. Extensive experiments reveal uneven capabilities across existing MLLMs and demonstrate that training on EgoOmniWorld improves in-domain performance and transfers to other egocentric benchmarks. We hope EgoOmniWorld provides a foundation for moving beyond fragmented capability evaluation toward more systematic and holistic understanding of human–world interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了EgoOmniWorld, 一个统一的基准, 通过将这一进程分为四个相辅相成的范围——节点、边缘、链子和环圈——我们为评估个别国家、指导关系、相互联系的依赖关系和反馈封闭的互动提供了一个共同框架。 我们的交互第一,以证据为基础的数据引擎,根据基本的交互要求,进一步将视觉证据和听觉证据与单向和多向的QA相融合. 广泛的实验揭示了现有小额供资和微型企业的不均衡能力,并表明关于 " EgoOmniWorld " 的培训能够改善域内的业绩并转而采用其他以自我为中心的基准。 我们希望EgoOmni World为超越零散的能力评估, 更系统、更全面地理解人类与世界的相互作用提供基础。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. While EgoOmniWorld provides a unified framework for egocentric video understanding, several directions remain for future exploration. First, our current dataset is constructed from Ego4D and HD-EPIC. Incorporating more diverse data sources, longer recordings, and richer annotations could further expand its coverage of interaction scenarios and temporal dependencies, potentially improving model generalization and real-world applicability. Second, our training experiments primarily focus on the Qwen-Omni family. Extending EgoOmniWorld supervision to a broader range of omni-modal architectures and training paradigms would further investigate its transferability and benefits for general-purpose egocentric assistants.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 虽然EgoOmniWorld为以自我为中心的视频理解提供了一个统一的框架,但未来探索仍有好几项方向. 首先,我们目前的数据集由Ego4D和HD-EPIC构建. 纳入更多样化的数据来源、较长的录音和内容更丰富的说明,可以进一步扩大其对相互作用假设情景和时间依赖性的涵盖范围,有可能改进模型的概括和现实世界的适用性。 第二,我们的培训实验主要集中于Quen-Omni家族。 将EgoOmniWorld的监督范围扩大到更广泛的全方位模式架构和培训范式,将进一步调查其可转让性和对普通用途自我中心助手的好处。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Statistics and Representative Examples
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集统计和代表实例

blocks.en: This section reports dataset composition, temporal coverage, and dialogue statistics, followed by representative QA examples. A single-turn QA or a complete multi-turn dialogue counts as one QA group throughout.
blocks.zh: 本节报告数据集的组成、时间覆盖面和对话统计,然后是有代表性的质量保证实例。 单回合QA或完整的多回合对话在整个过程中都是一个QA组.

blocks.en: Scale and task distribution. EgoOmniWorld contains 24,166 QA groups, comprising 20,284 training and 3,882 test samples. A QA group is either a standalone question or a complete multi-turn dialogue. Node, Edge, Chain, and Loop contain 10,026, 9,521, 2,480, and 2,139 samples, respectively, representing 41.49%, 39.40%, 10.26%, and 8.85% of the total. Node covers ego states, action dynamics, and world states, while Edge covers six directed interaction relations. Chain and Loop assess open relational paths and interactions with feedback closure, respectively (Table 4 ; Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 规模和任务分配。 EgoOmniWorld包含24,166个QA组,包括20,284个培训组和3,882个测试样本. 质量保证小组要么是一个独立的问题,要么是一个完整的多回合对话。 节点、边缘、链和环圈分别包含10,026、9,521,2,480和2,139个样本,分别占总数的41.49%、39.40%、10.26%和8.85%。 节点覆盖了自我状态,行动动态,以及世界状态,而边缘则覆盖了6个直接的互动关系. 链路和环路分别评估开放关系路径和与反馈关闭的相互作用(表4;图4)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Sample counts by task category and split. A multi-turn dialogue counts as one QA group.
blocks.zh: 表4:按任务类别和划分分列的样本。 多回合对话是一个QA组。

blocks.en: Video duration. Duration statistics cover the 23,246 samples with clip metadata, excluding the 920 restored samples for which new clips have not been generated. Deduplication by source video ID and temporal interval yields 10,664 clips: 8,892 in training and 1,772 in testing. According to the clip metadata, the mean and median durations are 57.2 and 34.5 seconds; 92.7% of clips are no longer than two minutes, and the longest lasts approximately 46.7 minutes. When weighted by QA groups within this subset, retaining repeated references to the same clip, the mean duration is 71.5 seconds and the median is 54.1 seconds. Samples associated with 30–60-second and 60–120-second clips account for 44.7% and 28.8%, respectively. The data therefore primarily cover short interactions while retaining samples that require understanding over longer temporal spans (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 视频持续时间。 持续时间统计涵盖23 246个有剪接元数据的样本,不包括尚未生成新剪接的920个恢复样本。 通过源视频ID和时间间隔的复制产生10,664个剪辑:8,892个在培训中,1,772个在测试中. 根据剪辑元数据,平均和中位数持续时间为57.2秒和34.5秒;92.7%的剪辑时间不超过2分钟,最长的会持续约46.7分钟. 当在这个子集内按QA组加权,保留重复引用同一片段时,平均持续时间为71.5秒,中位数为54.1秒. 与30-60秒和60-120秒相接的片段样本分别占44.7%和28.8%. 因此,这些数据主要涵盖短暂的相互作用,同时保留需要较长时间段了解的样本(图4)。

blocks.en: Question formats and dialogue settings. The dataset supports multiple-choice and open-ended questions. It contains 19,833 single-turn groups and 4,333 multi-turn dialogues, representing 82.07% and 17.93%, respectively. All multi-turn dialogues use open-ended answers.
blocks.zh: 提问格式和对话框设置。 数据集支持多选择和开放式问题. 它包含19,833个单回合小组和4,333个多回合对话,分别占82.07%和17.93%. 所有多回合对话都使用不限成员名额的答案。

blocks.en: Multi-turn dialogue length. The 4,333 multi-turn dialogues comprise 11,273 QA turns, averaging 2.60 turns per dialogue. Two-turn dialogues account for 1,750 samples (40.39%), three-turn dialogues for 2,559 (59.06%), and four-turn dialogues for 24 (0.55%). The data are dominated by compact two- and three-turn dialogues, which use successive questions to examine understanding of related facts and reasoning dependencies (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 多回合对话框长度 。 4 333个多回合对话包括11 273个质量保证回合,平均每个对话有2.6个回合。 两回合对话占1 750个样本(40.39%),三回合对话占2 559个(59.06%),四回合对话占24个(0.55%)。 数据以紧凑的二相和三相交替对话为主,这些对话利用相接的问题来研究相关事实的理解和推理依赖性(图4.).

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据构建细节

blocks.en: This appendix provides implementation details omitted from the main text, including video selection, interaction representations, category-specific QA generation, structural validation, constrained repair, and evidence provenance. The organization follows the interaction-first pipeline in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 本附录提供正文中省略的执行细节,包括视频选择,互动表述,特定类别QA生成,结构验证,受限修复,和出自证据等. 本组织遵循第3.2节中互动的第一个管道。

blocks.en: B.1 Source Videos and Provenance
blocks.zh: B.1 源视频和证据

blocks.en: Ego4D source selection uses narration-based clustering to promote activity diversity; the implementation and observed coverage appear below. HD-EPIC segments use official narrations and action intervals for candidate localization. Narrations are temporal anchors and provenance references, not substitutes for supporting evidence from the original audio and video.
blocks.zh: Ego4D源选择采用以叙述为基础的集群方式,以促进活动多样性;执行和观察到的覆盖范围见下文。 HD-EPIC部分使用正式的描述和动作间隔来进行候选本地化. 叙述是时间主播和出处参考,而不是取而代之的是原始音频和视频中的支持证据.

blocks.en: B.2 Interaction representation details
blocks.zh: B.2 互动表现细节

blocks.en: Local interaction components. For each candidate interaction, the engine extracts a structured record that includes the following components when supported by evidence: • the pre-action world state; • observations that trigger or contextualize the interaction; • the current intention or persistent activity goal; • the current decision or intermediate subgoal; • the action actually performed; • the resulting change in world state; • perceptual or task-level feedback; and • attention-related information when sufficiently supported.
blocks.zh: 本地交互组件. 对于每个候选互动,引擎会提取一个结构化的记录,其中包含有证据支持的下列组成部分: 行动前的世界状态; • 触发互动或使互动具有关联性的观察; • 当前的意图或持续的活动目标; • 当前的决定或中期次级目标; • 实际执行的行动; • 由此产生的世界状态变化; • 认知或任务层面反馈; 以及 • 得到充分支持的与关注有关的信息.

blocks.en: the pre-action world state;
blocks.zh: 行动前的世界状态;

blocks.en: observations that trigger or contextualize the interaction;
blocks.zh: 触发或使互动发生关联的观测;

blocks.en: the current intention or persistent activity goal;
blocks.zh: 目前的意图或持续的活动目标;

blocks.en: the current decision or intermediate subgoal;
blocks.zh: 现行决定或中期次级目标;

blocks.en: the action actually performed;
blocks.zh: 实际采取的行动;

blocks.en: the resulting change in world state;
blocks.zh: 随之而来的世界状况变化;

blocks.en: perceptual or task-level feedback; and
blocks.zh: 概念或任务一级的反馈;

blocks.en: attention-related information when sufficiently supported.
blocks.zh: (b) 在得到充分支持的情况下提供与关注有关的信息。

blocks.en: We distinguish these components by their functional roles. An intention is a relatively persistent goal, a subgoal is the currently selected intermediate step, and an action is an observable behavior that has been performed. In particular, a paraphrase of what the wearer is currently doing is not automatically an intention description.
blocks.zh: 我们用它们的职能作用来区分这些组成部分。 一个意图是一个相对持续的目标,一个次级目标是一个目前选定的中间步骤,一个行动是一个已经实现的可观察到的行为. 特别是,对穿戴者目前所作所为的一种解释并不是自动的意向描述.

blocks.en: For latent components such as intentions and decisions, records also preserve supporting observations, speech, or contextual information. Unsupported latent states remain unspecified rather than being completed through commonsense inference.
blocks.zh: 对于意图和决定等潜在组成部分,记录也保存支持性意见、言论或背景资料。 未证实的潜在状态仍未确定,而不是通过常识推断完成。

blocks.en: Multimodal perceptual enrichment. Visual evidence may describe object identities and attributes, spatial layouts, hand occupancy, hand–object interactions, the wearer’s surroundings, visible state changes, and changes in location. Auditory evidence may include speech, environmental sounds, action-generated sounds, sound-source identities, and relative source directions when available.
blocks.zh: 多式联运概念丰富。 视觉证据可以描述物体的特征和属性,空间布局,手占用,手-物体的相互作用,穿戴者的周围环境,可见的状态变化,以及位置的变化. 审计证据可能包括语音、环境声音、动作产生的声音、声音源身份以及可获得的相对源方向。

blocks.en: Each perceptual record is associated with its temporal interval and modality. When visual and auditory observations are considered jointly, the pipeline also records their correspondence within the interaction instead of assuming that temporal proximity implies semantic relevance.
blocks.zh: 每个感官记录都与其时间间隔和模式相关. 当视觉和听觉观测被联合考虑时,管道也会在相互作用中记录其通信,而不是假设时间相近意味着语义相关.

blocks.en: Component relations. The resulting local representation is a component graph whose nodes represent interaction components and whose edges represent candidate relations. Connectivity is treated as a structural hypothesis, not proof of causality. Relations used for QA generation must additionally pass the evidence checks for the relevant category.
blocks.zh: 构成部分关系。 由此产生的地方代表性是一个组成图,其节点代表互动组成部分,其边缘代表候选人关系。 连通性被视为一种结构假设,而不是因果关系的证据. 用于生成质量保证的关系必须另外通过相关类别的证据检查。

blocks.en: B.3 Entity Association and Episode Dependencies
blocks.zh: B.3 实体协会和附属实体

blocks.en: Object identity association. Object observations from different local interactions are associated only when they can reliably be identified as referring to the same physical entity. The resulting track stores observations in temporal order, including their states, locations, associated interactions, timestamps, and evidence sources.
blocks.zh: 对象身份协会. 不同局部相互作用的物体观测只有在可以可靠地被确定为指同个物理实体时才会相关联. 由此产生的跟踪记录了按时间顺序进行的观测,包括其状态、位置、相关的相互作用、时间戳和证据来源。

blocks.en: Only entity identity is merged; states observed at different times remain separate records. A track therefore preserves successive changes in an object’s state without collapsing temporally distinct observations into a single description.
blocks.zh: 只有实体身份被合并;在不同时间观察到的状态仍然是单独的记录. 因此,轨迹保留了物体状态的相继变化,而不将时间上不同的观测折成单一描述。

blocks.en: When identity cannot be reliably established, records remain separate. Similar names, shared semantic categories, or temporal proximity are insufficient grounds for merging.
blocks.zh: 当身份无法可靠地确定时,记录仍然分开。 类似名称,共享语义分类,或时间相近,不足以成为合并的理由.

blocks.en: Macro-level task aggregation. Local interactions are processed in temporally overlapping windows. Adjacent interactions that serve the same identifiable activity stage are grouped into a macro-level task episode. A new episode is created when the goal, principal object set, workspace, or activity changes substantially.
blocks.zh: 宏级任务汇总. 局部相互作用在时间上相重叠的窗口中处理. 服务于同一可识别活动阶段的相邻互动被分组为宏观层面的任务集. 当目标,主对象设定,工作空间,或活动发生实质性变化时,会创建出一集.

blocks.en: Each macro episode preserves its source events and, where recorded, its persistent intention, current subgoals, initial and resulting states, key entities, instructions, constraints, failures, interruptions, and unfinished tasks.
blocks.zh: 每个宏集保留其源事件,并在有记录的情况下保留其持续意图,当前的子目标,初始和结果状态,关键实体,指令,约束,失败,中断,和未完成的任务.

blocks.en: Episodes produced by overlapping windows are then reconciled. Duplicate episode descriptions are merged while preserving temporal order and event provenance.
blocks.zh: 由相重叠的窗口所生成的相接相接相接相接相接. 重复的插曲描述在保留时间顺序和事件出处的同时被合并.

blocks.en: Cross-episode relations. Candidate relations between macro episodes include state transfer, instruction following, failure correction, resumption of unfinished tasks, environmental constraints, and continuation of persistent goals as subgoals change.
blocks.zh: 跨集关系. 宏观事件之间的候选关系包括:国家转移、后续指示、失败纠正、恢复未完成的任务、环境限制、以及随着次级目标的变化而持续的目标。

blocks.en: Each relation stores its source and target episodes, relevant source events, connected interaction components, relation type, transferred information or state, required modalities, and uncertainty metadata. Relations with unresolved entity identity, state transfer, or semantic dependence are not used directly to generate questions.
blocks.zh: 每个关系存储其源和目标事件,相关源事件,相通的交互组件,关系类型,被传输的信息或状态,所需模式,以及不确定性元数据. 与未解决的实体身份,状态转移,或语义依赖的关系不直接用于产生问题.

blocks.en: B.4 Ego4D Clustering and Source Selection
blocks.zh: B.4. Ego4D 分组和源选择

blocks.en: The statistics below concern source-video selection, not QA counts. They match saved clustering outputs to the final selected video identifiers without rerunning clustering.
blocks.zh: 以下统计数据涉及源-视频选择,而非QA计数. 它们将已保存的集群输出匹配到最终选定的视频标识符,而不重运行集群.

blocks.en: Video-level narration representation and clustering. The clustering implementation combines summaries and action descriptions from the two available rounds of narrations for each video into a video-level text representation. Text cleaning removes markup, normalizes whitespace, and deduplicates repeated descriptions before concatenating summaries and action descriptions. TF–IDF features, truncated SVD, L2 normalization, and MiniBatch K-Means then group videos with similar narration content.
blocks.zh: 视频层面的叙事表现和分组. 分组执行将每段视频的两轮叙述摘要和行动说明合并成视频一级的文字说明。 文字清洗可以去除标记,使白空间正常化,并会在整理摘要和动作描述之前再重复描述. TF-IDF的功能,被截取的SVD,L2正常化,以及MiniBatch K-Means之后组合出类似叙述内容的视频.

blocks.en: The original clustering summary records the method as tfidf_svd_minibatch_kmeans , with random seed 42, covering 8,931 videos and 160 clusters. Each video retains its original identifier, cluster index, and distance to the corresponding cluster center. Cluster summaries also store frequent keywords and representative videos near the center to facilitate inspection and topic interpretation. Keywords aid interpretation; they are neither human activity labels nor validated semantic categories.
blocks.zh: 原始分组摘要记录了该方法为tfidf_svd_minibatch_kmeans. 有随机种子42,覆盖了8,931个视频和160个分组. 每段视频保留了原来的标识符,集群索引,并保持了与相应集群中心的距离. 集群摘要还经常在中心附近存储关键词和代表性视频,以方便检查和专题解读. 关键词帮助解释;它们既不是人类活动标签,也不是经过验证的语义类.

blocks.en: Candidate filtering and within-cluster ranking. The sampler first selects candidates with complete annotation status, valid video identifiers, and durations within the specified range. Importantly, duration_proxy_sec uses the maximum timestamp across the two narration rounds as a duration proxy rather than directly reading the media file’s duration. The filter therefore measures the temporal span covered by narrations.
blocks.zh: 候选人过滤和集群内部排名。 采样员首先选择具备完整注释状态,有效视频识别符,以及指定范围内持续时间的候选人. 重要的是,持续时间_proxy_sec使用两个叙述回合的最大时间戳作为持续时间的替代,而不是直接阅读媒体文件的持续时间。 因此,过滤器衡量叙述所涵盖的时间跨度。

blocks.en: The sampling budget first provides minimum coverage quotas for available clusters, then allocates additional places according to remaining candidate capacity, never exceeding a cluster’s capacity. Candidates are ranked primarily by ascending distance to the center, with descending narration density as a tie-breaker and video identifiers providing deterministic ordering. Narration density is computed as the narration count divided by the duration proxy floored at 60 seconds.
blocks.zh: 抽样预算首先为现有的集群提供最低的覆盖配额,然后根据剩余的候选能力分配额外名额,从未超过集群的能力。 候选人的排名主要通过向中心递升的距离来排列,递降的叙述密度作为断结符和视频识别符提供决定性命令. 叙述密度是按叙述次数除以持续时间的代理底数60秒来计算。

blocks.en: The saved sampling script defaults to a total budget of 1,000, a minimum quota of four per cluster, and a duration-proxy range of 180–3,600 seconds. These are verifiable script defaults, not confirmed historical execution parameters: the complete parameter record for the original run was not found during this audit. The observed distribution below comes directly from the final selected list and does not depend on assumptions about run parameters.
blocks.zh: 被保存的采样脚本默认为总预算为1000个,每个集群的最低配额为4个,持续时间-代用范围为180–3,600秒. 这些是可核查的脚本默认,而非被确认的历史执行参数:在这次审计中没有发现原始运行的完整参数记录. 以下观测到的分布直接出自最终选定的列表,并不取决于运行参数的假设.

blocks.en: Observed selection results and coverage.
blocks.zh: 观察选取结果和覆盖.

blocks.en: Table 5: Observed Ego4D source-video selection statistics.
blocks.zh: 表5:观察Ego4D源视频选择统计数据.

blocks.en: Cluster 39 is the only cluster with no selected video. It originally contains a single video whose narration-based duration proxy is approximately 92.3 seconds. This is consistent with the current script’s default exclusion of candidates below 180 seconds, but the historical exclusion reason cannot be established from default parameters alone. Clusters 7 and 112 have the most selected videos, with 12 each.
blocks.zh: 第39组是唯一没有选中视频的组. 它最初包含一个以叙述为基础的持续时间代理大约92.3秒的视频. 这符合当前脚本默认排除180秒以下候选人的做法,但仅凭默认参数无法确定历史排除原因. 第7组和第112组拥有最精选的视频,每组12个.

blocks.en: Cluster-stratified sampling aims to reduce budget domination by frequent activities under sampling based only on video counts, balancing activity coverage and within-cluster representativeness. It is not an unbiased estimate of the natural activity distribution and does not guarantee coverage of every fine-grained activity. Center-based ranking may reduce the inclusion probability of peripheral or rare activities; variations in narration wording may also distribute similar activities across multiple clusters. Coverage of 159/160 therefore refers only to the original clustering and does not mean that 159 mutually exclusive human-defined activity categories are covered.
blocks.zh: 分组抽样旨在减少预算支配,办法是只根据视频计数进行频繁的抽样活动,平衡活动覆盖面和分组内的代表性。 它并非对自然活动分布的无偏倚估计,也不保证涵盖每起精细活动。 基于中心的排名可能会降低外围活动或稀有活动的包含概率;叙述措辞的变异也可能将类似活动分布在多组别之间. 因此,159/160的涵盖范围仅指最初的分组,并不意味着涵盖159个相互排斥的人类界定的活动类别。

blocks.en: Cluster topics and selected-video distribution. The following table preserves the original cluster indices and counts. Topic labels are translated from the Chinese summaries derived from original keywords and representative narrations; they are provided for readability, not as original human annotations. Heterogeneous clusters are marked “mixed.” For example, crochet, yarn crochet, and hook-based crochet may occur in different clusters without constituting mutually exclusive activity categories. “All” denotes the original cluster size, while “Selected” denotes the number of videos from the final 1,000-video subset in that cluster. The first six keywords are retained from the original summaries.
blocks.zh: 集群主题和所选视频分布. 下表保留了原来的集群指数和计数. 主题标签由出自原始关键词和代表性说明的中文摘要翻译而来;为可读性而提供,不是作为原始人名说明. 异相星团被标记为"混合". 例如,线粒体、线粒体和以钩为基础的线粒体可能在不同集群中发生,而不构成相互排斥的活动类别。 “所有”表示原始组群大小,而“所选”表示该组中最后1000个视频子集的视频数量。 前6个关键词保留自原文摘要.

blocks.en: Table 6: Original Ego4D clusters and selected source videos. Topic summaries are interpretive, not human-annotated activity classes.
blocks.zh: 表6:原始Ego4D集群和所选源视频. 专题摘要是解释性的,而不是人类附加说明的活动类别。

blocks.en: Traceable records. These statistics are based on the original cluster_summary.json , video_clusters.jsonl , and final selected_video_uids.txt . The accompanying selected_1000_cluster_mapping.json stores each selected video’s identifier, original cluster index, Chinese topic summary, and distance to the cluster center, enabling verification of selection results and downstream video provenance. Topic summaries provide interpretation only and do not change original cluster assignments, selected-video lists, or counts.
blocks.zh: 可追踪的记录。 这些统计数据基于原始集群_摘要.json , video_clusters.jsonl,以及最终被选中的_video_uids.txt. 所附带的所选_1000_cluster_mapping.json存储了每个所选视频的标识符,原集索引,中文专题摘要,以及到集成中心的距离,从而能够验证选择结果和下游视频出处. 专题摘要仅提供口译,不改变原群组任务、选定的录像清单或计数。

blocks.en: Appendix C QA Generation and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 附录C 质量保证和质量控制

blocks.en: This section specifies evidence bindings, category-specific answer requirements, and the dependencies used to construct multi-turn questions.
blocks.zh: 本节具体规定了证据约束,类别特定答案要求,以及用于构建多回合问题的依赖性.

blocks.en: C.1 Evidence binding
blocks.zh: 页:1 证据具有约束力

blocks.en: Each candidate QA is generated from an explicit evidence specification containing the video identifier, event identifiers, temporal intervals, target component or relation, natural-language evidence descriptions, and required modalities.
blocks.zh: 每个候选人的质量保证来自一个明确的证据说明,其中包含视频标识符、事件标识符、时间间隔、目标组成部分或关系、自然语证据说明以及所需模式。

blocks.en: For multi-turn QA, we distinguish the evidence types in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 对于多回合QA,我们区分表7中的证据类型。

blocks.en: Table 7: Evidence types in multi-turn QA.
blocks.zh: 表7:多回合质量保证中的证据类型。

blocks.en: Previously generated QA pairs may inform question wording, but they are never used as evidence for new answers.
blocks.zh: 以前产生的QA配对可能为质疑措辞提供参考,但它们从未被作为新答案的证据.

blocks.en: Available versus required modalities. A modality is marked as required only if removing it removes information necessary to answer the question. Audio-visual questions therefore require complementary information from both modalities, rather than merely originating from videos that contain both audio and visual streams.
blocks.zh: 可用模式与所需模式。 一种模式只有在删除回答问题所必需的信息时才按要求标记。 因此,视听问题需要两种模式的补充信息,而不只是来自包含视听流的视频。

blocks.en: C.2 Semantic QA categories
blocks.zh: C.2 语义学质量保证类别

blocks.en: The three Node categories describe individual states, while the six Edge categories describe directed relations. Chain and Loop capture composed dependencies and feedback closure, respectively. Modality requirements and dialogue formats are separate annotation axes; neither the number of turns nor the available media streams alone determines the interaction scope.
blocks.zh: 三个节点类别描述了单个状态,而六个边缘类别则描述了定向关系. 链和循环捕捉分别由依赖和反馈关闭组成。 模式要求和对话格式是单独的注释轴;转弯次数和可用的媒体流本身并不决定互动范围.

blocks.en: Table 8: Semantic categories, query targets, and evidence requirements.
blocks.zh: 表8:语义分类、查询目标和证据要求。

blocks.en: C.3 Multi-turn construction
blocks.zh: C.3 多回合建设

blocks.en: Multi-turn samples contain two to four turns and are constructed through dependency-driven composition. Earlier turns establish intermediate facts, while later turns combine inherited information with newly introduced audio-visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 多回合抽样包含2至4个回合,通过依赖驱动的成分构建。 早先转而确定中间事实,而后来转而将所继承的信息与新引进的视听证据结合起来.

blocks.en: For a multi-turn sample, the final answer depends on information established in earlier turns together with new evidence introduced for the final turn.
blocks.zh: 对于多回合抽样,最后的答案取决于早先回合确定的信息,以及最后回合引入的新证据。

blocks.en: The final turn must cover the relevant endpoints of the claimed relation through direct or inherited evidence. Candidates are excluded if their final answers can be obtained solely from previous textual answers without consulting the new video evidence. For Loop questions, the multi-turn evidence must collectively cover the original goal, action, outcome, and feedback returning to the ego; Cross-loop questions must additionally cover inter-loop dependencies. Covering two event endpoints or introducing a new evidence field does not by itself demonstrate closure.
blocks.zh: 最后回合必须通过直接证据或继承证据涵盖索赔关系的相关终点。 如果候选人的最终答案仅取自之前的文字答案,而不参考新的视频证据,则被排除在外. 对于循环问题,多回合证据必须集体涵盖原始目标、行动、结果和反馈回归自我;跨循环问题必须额外涵盖跨循环依赖。 涵盖两个事件终点或引入一个新的证据领域本身并不表明结束。

blocks.en: Where available, we retain standalone versions of constituent questions with matched answer targets and evidence, enabling controlled comparisons between atomic reasoning and dialogue-based compositional reasoning.
blocks.zh: 如果有的话,我们保留独立的组成问题版本,并配有对应的答案目标和证据,从而能够在原子推理和以对话为基础的组成推理之间进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en: The following checks assess candidate validity, structure, and evidence requirements. Cross-loop reasoning is treated as a subtype of Loop, not a fifth top-level category.
blocks.zh: 以下检查评估候选人的有效性、结构和证据要求。 Cross-loop推理被视作Loop的子类型,而不是第五个顶级类别.

blocks.en: C.4 General quality checks
blocks.zh: C.4 一般质量检查

blocks.en: All generated QA pairs are initially treated as candidates. We check field completeness, video and event references, temporal intervals, evidence–source alignment, modality consistency, duplication, and answer consistency. Multiple-choice samples additionally require valid, non-duplicate options and designated answers consistent with those options.
blocks.zh: 所有生成的QA对最初都作为候选人对待. 我们检查字段完整性、视频和事件参考、时间间隔、证据-源对齐、方式一致性、重复和回答一致性。 多重选择样本还需要有效、不重复的选项和符合这些选项的指定答案。

blocks.en: Semantic review checks whether the attributes, states, sounds, intentions, and relations in an answer are supported by its bound evidence. It also detects unsupported details, answer leakage, and mismatches between declared modalities and those actually required to answer.
blocks.zh: 语义审查检查一个答案中的属性,状态,声音,意图和关系是否得到其约束证据的支持. 它还检测不支持的细节,解答漏出,以及申报方式与实际需要解答方式之间的不匹配.

blocks.en: For multi-turn QA, we additionally inspect turn dependencies, inherited evidence, newly introduced evidence, and whether earlier turns prematurely reveal the final answer.
blocks.zh: 对于多回合的QA,我们额外检查了转折的依赖性,继承的证据,新引入的证据,以及早前是否过早地揭示出最终答案.

blocks.en: C.5 Category-specific structural filtering
blocks.zh: C.5 特定类别的结构过滤

blocks.en: Table 9: Structural filtering criteria.
blocks.zh: 表9:结构过滤标准。

blocks.en: C.6 Language shortcuts and modality audits
blocks.zh: C.6 语文快捷方式和方式审计

blocks.en: We conduct text-only answering tests to identify samples whose answers can primarily be inferred from question wording, dialogue history, or recurring templates without the intended audio-visual evidence. These samples are flagged as potential language shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 我们只进行文字回答测试,以查明主要可从问题措辞、对话历史或没有预定视听证据的反复出现的模板中推断答案的样本。 这些样本被标记为潜在的语言快捷键.

blocks.en: Inspired by VisNec Dong et al. [2026] , we also evaluate modality necessity. For audio-visual samples, if either modality alone fully determines the answer, the sample is considered to contain modality redundancy. For cross-modal relations, visual and auditory observations must participate in the same interaction or provide complementary evidence for the target relation.
blocks.zh: 受到维斯尼克的启发 董等 [2026],我们也评价模式必要性. 就视听样本而言,如果只有两种模式中的任何一种能完全确定答案,则样本被认为含有模式冗余。 对于跨模式关系,视觉和听觉观测必须参与相同的互动或为目标关系提供补充证据.

blocks.en: C.7 Constrained Repair and Revalidation
blocks.zh: C.7 限制修理和改装

blocks.en: This section defines which edits are permitted, the structural properties they must preserve, and how repaired candidates are checked again.
blocks.zh: 本节定义了允许编辑的哪些内容,必须保存的结构属性,以及如何再次检查被修复的候选人.

blocks.en: Candidates with repairable errors enter constrained repair. Editing is limited to the existing evidence pool and the original reasoning target. The editor may accept , rewrite , reject , or refer the candidate for review .
blocks.zh: 有可修复错误的候选人进入限制修复。 编辑仅限于现有的证据集合和原推理目标. 编辑可以接受、改写、拒绝或推荐候选人接受审查。

blocks.en: Category-specific repairs.
blocks.zh: 具体类别维修.

blocks.en: Table 10: Permitted repairs and constraints.
blocks.zh: 表10:允许的修理和限制。

blocks.en: Loop repair must preserve the connection from the original goal or subgoal to an action, the resulting world change, perceptual feedback, and confirmation, adjustment, or updating of the original goal.
blocks.zh: 循环修复必须保持原始目标或次级目标与行动的联系、由此而来的世界变化、认知反馈以及原始目标的确认、调整或更新。

blocks.en: Repair can only clarify closure already supported by the evidence. Phrases such as “therefore realized” or “confirmed success” cannot supply missing links. Closure determination requires semantic review; field completeness, graph connectivity, or a model’s validation pass alone does not prove closure.
blocks.zh: 修复只能澄清证据已经证明的结案。 “因此实现”或“确认成功”等词语不能提供缺失的链接。 关闭的确定需要语义审查;实地完整性,图通性,或一个模型的验证传出不能证明关闭.

blocks.en: General repair rules. Permitted edits include resolving referential ambiguity, removing answer leakage and unsupported details, adjusting answers to an evidence-supported abstraction level, correcting modality labels, adjusting existing evidence bindings, removing redundant reasoning components, and converting multiple-choice questions to open-ended ones when valid distractors cannot be constructed.
blocks.zh: 通则修行. 所允许的编辑包括解决了偏好模糊,去掉了答案渗漏和不支持的细节,将答案调整到一个有证据支持的抽象级,纠正了模式标签,调整了现有的证据绑定,去掉了多余的推理组件,在无法构建出有效的分光器时,将多选择问题转换为开放式问题.

blocks.en: Repairs must not introduce facts outside the existing evidence pool, add unrelated events to increase reasoning complexity, change the prediction cutoff, or alter the underlying reasoning target. Samples requiring additional video evidence, new clipping, or substantial restructuring are rejected or referred for review.
blocks.zh: 修补不得将事实引入到现有证据集合之外,增加不相干的事件来增加推理的复杂性,改变预测截断,或改变基本的推理目标. 需要额外视频证据、新剪辑或重大结构调整的样本被驳回或提交审查。

blocks.en: Revalidation. After repair, we repeat deterministic and category-specific validation. Goal Planning samples also undergo pre-decision evidence checks to ensure that future information has not entered the repaired question or answer.
blocks.zh: 复入正觉. 修复后,我们重复确定性和特定类别的验证。 " 目标规划 " 样本还接受决策前证据检查,以确保未来信息没有输入修复的问答。

blocks.en: A separate validation call then evaluates the repaired QA directly against its bound evidence, without access to the editor’s rationale. Samples that remain unsupported, ambiguous, incorrectly formatted, or structurally inconsistent are rejected or referred for review.
blocks.zh: 然后,一个单独的验证电话直接对照其约束性证据对修复的QA进行评估,而无法获得编辑的理由。 不支持、模棱两可、格式不正确或结构不一致的样本将被拒绝或提交审查。

blocks.en: Appendix D Human Review
blocks.zh: 附录D 人文审查

blocks.en: This section describes the sampled review cohort, the review interface, and the scope and limitations of human inspection.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍抽样审查组群、审查接口以及人员视察的范围和局限性。

blocks.en: To complement automatic quality control, we manually inspected a randomly sampled subset of QA groups. The review records were sampled without replacement using a fixed seed (20260921). Sampling was performed at the sample level: multi-turn dialogues were retained as complete groups rather than split into individual turns. Review coverage for the current inventory requires matching the retained sample identifiers to the review records; we do not infer it from the dataset size.
blocks.zh: 为了补充自动质量控制,我们人工检查了随机抽取的QA分组. 审查记录是在没有使用固定种子(20260921)替换的情况下取样的。 在抽样一级进行了抽样:多回合对话被保留为完整的小组,而不是分成个别回合。 现有清单的审查范围要求将保留的抽样识别资料与审查记录相匹配;我们不从数据集大小推断。

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows the web interface used to support this inspection. It presents the corresponding video clip, questions, reference answers, evidence intervals, modality labels, and reasoning categories together. The review criteria cover answer consistency with the audio-visual content, evidence sufficiency and temporal alignment, modality-label correctness, and the validity of the assigned reasoning structure. In particular, Chain questions require an open dependency path, whereas Loop questions require feedback closure; repeated nodes or multiple dialogue turns alone do not establish a Loop.
blocks.zh: 图7显示用于支持本次检查的网络界面. 它给出了相应的视频剪辑,提问,参考答案,证据间隔,模式标签,以及推理类加在一起. 审查标准涵盖与视听内容、证据充足性和时间一致性、模式标签正确性以及指定推理结构的有效性的答案一致性。 特别是,链子问题需要一个开放的依赖路径,而循环问题需要反馈关闭;重复的节点或多对话框单独转动不会建立循环.

blocks.en: The interface supports recording an accept , needs revision , reject , or uncertain decision, together with issue labels, reviewer notes, and turn-level editing suggestions. Suggested edits are stored separately from the original annotations to preserve traceability. Samples whose media or supporting evidence cannot be verified should remain uncertain rather than be treated as validated. This sampled inspection does not constitute exhaustive human verification of the entire test set.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. LoRA uses the LLaMA-Factory target setting all , rank 8, and scaling factor 16. The eight-GPU configuration uses one example per device and two gradient-accumulation steps, giving an effective batch size of 16. FFT uses the same batch configuration with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 and updates the Thinker, including its visual and audio components, without training speech generation.

blocks.en: Qwen3-Omni. The expert-LoRA implementation targets the attention projections q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , and o_proj , and additionally injects adapters into 96 fused expert parameters whose names end in gate_up_proj or down_proj . Rank and scaling factor are 8 and 16. The saved four-GPU configuration uses one example per device and four accumulation steps, yielding an effective batch size of 16. FFT uses DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 with the same four-GPU batch configuration. Both configurations disable thinking during training. Later continuation launches must be distinguished from these initial configurations when reproducing a particular checkpoint.

blocks.en: Shared optimization and checkpointing. LoRA and FFT use learning rates of 0.00002 and 0.000002, respectively, cosine decay, and 3% warm-up. Both use BF16, FlashAttention-2, non-reentrant gradient checkpointing, a sequence-length limit of 32,768, and four data-loader workers per process. The saved configurations specify ten epochs, epoch-wise checkpointing without a checkpoint-retention limit, and no intermediate validation. The setting mask_history=false retains supervision on earlier assistant answers in multi-turn training examples. These configuration values describe scheduled training, not a claim that every reported checkpoint completed ten epochs.

blocks.en: E.2 Evaluation Protocol and Reproducibility

blocks.en:
Saved evaluation manifests and run configurations document the scope underlying the reported results.
We evaluate models on the test set. Records are deduplicated by sample identifier and round index, and dialogue history is retained. Predictive questions use cutoff-safe clips. Saved manifests specify evaluation membership and annotation provenance.
The Qwen3-Omni-Thinking LoRA results use the second-epoch checkpoint, with no failed judgments. Categories follow the frozen V9 taxonomy and saved item labels. Reproducibility requires the checkpoint identifiers, input settings, scoring protocols, and evaluation manifests for each model and transfer benchmark.

We distinguish evidential sufficiency , structural dependence , and causal certainty .
Node, Edge, Chain, and Loop are defined by the reasoning
dependencies required to answer a question, rather than by

closure. Loop questions additionally require connecting action

decisions. Cross-event relations alone do not establish such
closure. These structural labels characterize the required
reasoning, but do not by themselves establish causal certainty.
